A conflict means the same master row changed on this phone and in the cloud since the previous sync. The app keeps both sides unchanged and reports the conflict instead of overwriting silently.

v158 starts automatic foreground synchronization for core company master data. Sales invoices, purchases, stock movements, accounting entries and production transactions are still local-only in this release.

v160 mirrors posted sales invoices, invoice lines and cost allocations, customer receipts and allocations, and sales returns from the OWNER/ADMIN company phone to employee phones, with exact conflict inspection.
Sales and receivables have not been synchronized on this phone yet.
Skipped %1$d local-only transaction documents on this employee phone.
The sales and receivables cloud baseline was initialized from this OWNER/ADMIN phone.
The company sales cloud baseline is empty. Run the first v159 sales sync on the OWNER/ADMIN phone before employee phones.
The v159 sales cloud tables are not installed. Run cloud/supabase/004_sales_receivables_mirror.sql in Supabase first.
The cloud returned an invalid sales/receivables response.

Safety: v159 is an OWNER/ADMIN-authored mirror. Employee phones download company sales/receivables; local employee-only transaction documents are not uploaded yet. Purchase, stock movement, journal and production side effects remain local until their dedicated sync waves.

v160 keeps the Sales & Receivables mirror and adds a non-destructive conflict inspector. Purchases, stock movements, general accounting vouchers/journals and production transactions are still outside this cloud wave.
v160 identifies the exact sales/receivables documents and business fields that differ. It never overwrites either copy automatically.
Protected: the local document and the company cloud copy were both preserved for review.

v161 mirrors posted purchase invoices, invoice lines and purchase returns from the OWNER/ADMIN company phone to employee phones. Supplier payments, stock movements, treasury and journal side effects remain local for later waves.
Purchase documents have not been synchronized on this phone yet.
Skipped %1$d local-only purchase documents on this employee phone.
The purchase documents cloud baseline was initialized from this OWNER/ADMIN phone.
The company purchase cloud baseline is empty. Run the first v161 purchase sync on the OWNER/ADMIN phone before employee phones.
The v161 purchase cloud tables are not installed. Run cloud/supabase/005_purchase_documents_mirror.sql in Supabase first.
The cloud returned an invalid purchase documents response.

Safety: v161 mirrors purchase documents only. It does not replay stock movements, supplier payments, treasury entries or accounting journals, preventing duplicate inventory or financial side effects on employee phones.
v162 identifies the exact purchase invoices/returns and business fields that differ. It preserves both copies and does not replay stock, supplier payment, treasury, or journal side effects.
Protected: both the local purchase document and the company cloud copy were preserved. Review the differences before any manual resolution.
v163 mirrors the treasury-account directory and supplier payments with invoice allocations from the OWNER/ADMIN company phone to employee phones.
Supplier payments and treasury directory have not been synchronized on this phone yet.

The cloud returned an invalid supplier-payment or treasury response.
Supplier payments and treasury synchronization failed.

Safety: v163 mirrors supplier payment documents and treasury directory metadata only. It does not replay journal entries, generic receipt/payment vouchers, cash counts, bank reconciliation, FX revaluation, inventory or production side effects.
v163 preserves both copies when supplier-payment or treasury business fields differ. No financial document is overwritten automatically.
Protected: local and cloud copies were preserved for review.

v163 adds supplier-payment and treasury-directory mirroring after master data, sales, and purchase documents. Generic treasury vouchers, general journals, inventory movements, and production transactions remain outside this cloud wave.
v167 enables operational two-way synchronization for inventory and newly closed production orders. Authorized PRODUCTION/INVENTORY users can publish changes with conflict detection before overwrite.
Inventory and production have not been synchronized on this phone yet.

The v167 inventory/production cloud database layer is incomplete. Run cloud/supabase/008_inventory_production_mirror.sql and then 009_bidirectional_inventory_production.sql in Supabase.
The cloud returned an invalid inventory/production response.

Safety: v167 does not replay sales, purchase or production posting services on other phones. Only newly closed production orders can be published by PRODUCTION users, and inventory uses conditional compare-and-set updates so newer cloud changes are not overwritten. General-ledger journals remain out of scope.
Local production documents and inventory balances are compared with the company cloud copy. If both sides changed since the previous sync, both copies are preserved and a conflict is shown.
Protected: both the local production copy and the company cloud copy were preserved for review.
v177 adds bidirectional general-ledger and treasury-voucher synchronization with explicit conflict resolution and treasury balance reconciliation after operational document synchronization.

v177 synchronizes posted journal entries with all lines plus generic treasury/party vouchers as immutable cloud documents. Same document number with different accounting content becomes an explicit conflict instead of silent overwrite.
